WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    s.arcref,
    MAX(p.fundflux) as fundflux,
    AVG(CAST(s.gbsize AS REAL) / CAST(s.spanmin AS REAL)) as rate
  FROM scans s
  JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0
  GROUP BY s.arcref
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM project_rates
)
SELECT 
  pr.arcref,
  pr.fundflux,
  pr.rate,
  pr.rate - b.avg_rate as gap
FROM project_rates pr
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE pr.rate > b.avg_rate
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10
